column1: # tests/perf_budgets.tsv - helper-spawn, ssh-connection and zfs-call budgets
# 8 datasets x 2 snapshots), enforced by tests/test_zxfer_microbench_budgets.sh
# and equal to it for the exact rows below.
# Scenarios: noop, dryrun_incr and incr (the default CLI fixture),
# remote_noop and remote_incr (noop and incr with -O localhost -T localhost
# through the socket-aware mock ssh), and props (incr with -P and 68
# properties per dataset that already match).
# Metrics: TOTAL (every counted helper spawn), ssh_connections and
# ssh_master_opens, and the zfs call counters from -V (profile:zfs_*_calls).
# The per-helper and other profile rows that tests/run_microbench.sh prints
# are for diagnosis and are not budgeted.
# RATCHET-DOWN-ONLY: a budget may only decrease. When a change lowers an
# observed count, lower max to ceil(observed * 1.15) in the same change.
# Never raise a budget to make a regression pass: a failure means the change
# reintroduced per-run spawns or zfs calls that were pinned away.
# EXACT ROWS: ssh_connections and ssh_master_opens hold exactly the observed
# count, checked in both directions. One extra connection is a full
# handshake; a lower count means a scenario stopped reaching ssh the way it
# should. Lower them only when a change really opens fewer connections.
# Never budget advisory:* rows: wall time is noise, not a contract.
# The history of every ratchet is in CHANGELOG.txt. On 2026-09-26 (W10) the
# file kept only these rows of the 450 it had: the full-fixture rows were
# never enforced, and the per-helper rows duplicated TOTAL.
